upstream.description: Fine tune an LLM model to answer questions from your documents.

classification.analysis: A Google Cloud Platform-maintained Terraform module that stands up an end-to-end generative-AI knowledge-base pipeline: Document AI OCR extracts text from uploaded documents, Vertex AI generates question/answer pairs stored in Firestore, results are indexed in Vector Search, and the QA pairs feed fine-tuning of a Vertex AI LLM. It's for platform/infra engineers who want a deployable reference architecture (published to the Terraform Registry) rather than application code, wiring together Cloud Functions, Firestore, Document AI, and Vertex AI via HCL. Actively maintained with dependabot/renovate and periodic CI.

use_cases.title: Deploy a GCP knowledge-base pipeline with Terraform
Auto-generate a fine-tuning dataset from document text via Vertex AI
Provision Document AI OCR plus Vector Search infrastructure as code
